lounges.title: Narita Airport Paid Lounge
lounges.description: Business Hours: 07:30-21:00. Fare: 9200 JPY. Fare Notes: Children under 2 years old are free. The above rates apply to purchases made on or after July 1, 2026. Basic Services: Meals, Drinks (soft drinks, alcohol), Free Wi-Fi, Toilet facilities, Shower facilities. Service Notes: Food and beverages cannot be brought into the lounge. Additional options cannot be purchased directly at the lounge reception. Guests cannot stay beyond the lounge closing time. How To Use: Present the receipt for the lounge coupon purchased from ZIPAIR. Print the receipt in advance if needed. Applicable Routes: Bangkok, Singapore, Honolulu, Los Angeles, San Jose, San Francisco, Vancouver.

lounges.title: Honolulu Airport Paid Lounge
lounges.description: Business Hours: 07:00-ZIPAIR Departure Time.Fare: 38 USD.Fare Notes: Free for children under 1 year old.Basic Services: Light Meals & Snacks (Cup noodles, chips, nuts, pound cake), Alcohol (Hawaiian craft beer, wine, shochu), Soft drinks, Coffee & Tea, Free Wi-Fi.Service Notes: The types of food and beverages are subject to change. When the flight is full, the service may not be available. In that case, a meal coupon will be provided.How To Use: Present the receipt for the lounge coupon purchased from ZIPAIR. Print the receipt in advance if needed.Applicable Routes: None.
